print(install_out)

import asyncio
await asyncio.sleep(5)
fire_check = await run_command('python -c "import fire; print(\'ok\')"')
print(fire_check)

word_output = await run_command("python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/word/read_file.py --file_path /workspace/testbed/docs/Meeting_Notes_2024_06.docx")
print(word_output)

# Parse the tool output to extract just the paragraph text
# The OfficeBench tool typically outputs: "OBSERVATION: The following is the content from the word file:\n<content>"
raw = word_output.strip()

# Remove trailing (.venv) prompt if present
if raw.endswith("(.venv)"):
    raw = raw[:raw.rfind("(.venv)")].strip()

# Check if there's an OBSERVATION prefix
if "OBSERVATION:" in raw:
    # Extract everything after the first line containing OBSERVATION
    obs_idx = raw.index("OBSERVATION:")
    after_obs = raw[obs_idx:]
    # Find the end of the OBSERVATION header line
    newline_idx = after_obs.find("\n")
    if newline_idx != -1:
        paragraph_content = after_obs[newline_idx+1:].strip()
    else:
        # Everything is on one line after the colon
        colon_idx = after_obs.index(":")
        paragraph_content = after_obs[colon_idx+1:].strip()
else:
    # No OBSERVATION prefix, use the raw output
    paragraph_content = raw

print(f"Extracted paragraph content ({len(paragraph_content)} chars):")
print(repr(paragraph_content))

await write_file("./Meeting_Notes_2024_06.txt", paragraph_content)
print("File written successfully.")
